title: IPIP Altruism — 10 items
source: International Personality Item Pool, preliminary NEO-like facet A3: Altruism. IPIP item set, not the proprietary NEO-PI-R instrument.

instruction: Indicate how accurately the following statement describes you as you generally are now. Respond as yourself, not as a fictional character. Each statement completes: I...

items.text: Have a good word for everyone.
Am indifferent to the feelings of others.
